Listen to the conversation and answer the questions.

Maria: Hey Lucy! How have you been?

Lucy: Hi Maria! Fine, and you?

Maria: Fine. I’m just on my way to see Mark.

Lucy: Oh, I haven’t seen him for so long. The last time we talked he told me he wasn’t happy with his job and needed a change. Has he found a new one?

Maria: So you haven’t heard, have you?

Lucy: No, what’s happened??

Maria: He was tired of his routine. He said he wanted to find something he was passionate about.

Lucy: Mark? A nursery teacher? I think I need to sit down for a moment.

GlossaryGlossary

passion (n) a strong enthusiasm or interest

rewarding (adj) giving you satisfaction, pleasure or profit
